# Example Project — Vision

## Intent
Example Project gives a team one clear, shared picture of what it is building and
what a good change looks like, so contributors move quickly without drifting apart.
It exists to make the intent behind the work explicit and durable.

## Principles
- Clarity first — prefer the simplest design a newcomer can follow.
- Tested by default — every change ships with a test that proves it works.
- Small, reversible steps — favor incremental change over large rewrites.
- Consistency over cleverness — do the same kind of thing the same way.
